examples.title: Live stream
examples.description: Continuous execution logs for an active agent run.
examples.behavior: Append new rows without stealing scroll position from users inspecting history.
examples.qa: Timestamps and payloads remain scan-friendly at high density.

examples.title: Filtered results
examples.description: Log stream scoped by severity, text query or source filter.
examples.behavior: Show active filter context and keep copy/export scoped to visible rows.
examples.qa: Filtered state cannot be confused with an empty source.

examples.title: Empty stream
examples.description: No rows match current filters or the run has not emitted logs.
examples.behavior: Explain whether filters or upstream silence produced the empty result.
examples.qa: Recovery path is visible near the toolbar.

examples.title: Failed row
examples.description: A log row highlights a runtime failure.
examples.behavior: Use row-level error emphasis instead of turning the whole console into an alert.
examples.qa: Error row is readable and copyable.

streaming.qa: New rows append without layout jumps.

empty.trigger: No logs or filters exclude all rows

error.qa: Error row is distinct and copyable.

mobile.qa: Payload wraps without horizontal scroll traps.
